---
title: "Randomized study on driving reduction strategies"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(mu_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(mu_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(s_A, subscript(s, "A"))
hook(s_B, subscript(s, "B"))

task <- "tgroups4"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))


## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:50, 1)
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-10:10, 1)

  mu_A <- round(runif(1, 150, 250), 1)
  mu_B <- round(runif(1, 180, 300), 1)

  s_A <- round(runif(1, 60, 100), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 60, 100), 1)

  if(n_A == n_B)
    next

  s2_pool <- ((n_A - 1) * s_A^2 + (n_B - 1) * s_B^2) / (n_A + n_B - 2)

  tratio <- (mu_A - mu_B) / sqrt(s2_pool * (1/n_A + 1/n_B))

  if(abs(tratio) < 0.5 || abs(tratio) > 3.0)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(tgroups4, tgroups(n_A, mu_A, s_A, n_B, mu_B, s_B), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options = list(preproc = as.rolog), env = environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(
  "Condition A" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_A), sprintf("%.1f", mu_A), sprintf("%.1f", s_A)), 
  "Condition B" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_B), sprintf("%.1f", mu_B), sprintf("%.1f", s_B)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

row.names(tab) <- c("Sample size", "Mean distance (km)", "Standard deviation (km)")


t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========
In an environmental psychology study, researchers investigated strategies for reducing car use. 
Participants installed a smartphone app that tracked the distance they traveled by car. 
They were randomly assigned to two conditions. Condition A received financial incentives 
for reducing their driving distance, whereas Condition B received information 
about the negative effects of carbon dioxide emissions on global warming. 
The total distance traveled by car (in km) over four weeks was recorded using the app. 
Consider the following data:


````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align=c("c", "c", "l"))
````

Assuming equal population variances, calculate the $t$-statistic 
for the difference between between the group averages.
A positive $t$-statistic ($t>0$) should indicate superiority of the carbon dioxide intervention.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $t$-statistic is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
